title: Tall and Short
short: Compare heights from the same floor.

blocks.html: Some things are tall and some are short. To compare, stand them on the same floor. The one whose top is highest is the tallest.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which tower is the tallest? Which is the shortest?

blocks.html: Start on the same floor. The tallest one reaches the highest.

For the grown-up: Build block towers together and compare. Stand back to back with your child to see who is taller. Measure stuffed animals by standing them in a line. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Build towers and compare them.
Line up stuffed animals from short to tall.
Mark your child’s height on a paper strip.
